document_metadata.title: 1、INT. DEATH ROW/CELL - DAWN
document_metadata.summary: Marcus Wright, a death-row inmate, signs over his body to Project Angel, run by terminally ill Dr. Serena Kogan, who believes his donation may help advance experimental medical research.

entities.name: Marcus Wright stares at the ceiling while smoking a cigarette
entities.description: Marcus lies on his cot in his prison cell, staring upward and smoking a cigarette, showing disinterest in the priest's presence.

entities.description: A priest sits beside Marcus Wright in his cell, reading from the Bible in an attempt to provide spiritual comfort.

entities.name: Marcus Wright blows smoke toward the priest
entities.description: In a dismissive act, Marcus exhales cigarette smoke in the direction of the priest, who reacts by closing the Bible and blinking.

entities.name: Guard unlocks cell door for Dr. Serena Kogan

entities.name: Marcus Wright

document_metadata.title: 29、EXT. MOTEL - NIGHT
document_metadata.summary: Marcus, Kyle, and Star flee in a Jeep; Marcus destroys a pursuing aerostat with a thrown lug wrench, stunning them all with his strength.

entities.name: Jeep is pushed from carport to initiate escape
entities.description: Marcus and Kyle push the Jeep out of the carport while Star sits in the driver's seat, positioning the vehicle on a slope to gain momentum for starting.

entities.name: Star attempts to start hot-wired Jeep
entities.description: Star releases the clutch after depressing the clutch pedal fully, causing the Jeep to buck and sputter before successfully starting.

entities.name: Heavy metal music blares from Jeep's tape deck
entities.description: As the Jeep starts, a cassette tape begins playing loud heavy metal music that speeds and slows erratically, startling Star.

entities.name: Star nearly crashes Jeep into wall
entities.description: After being distracted by the music, Star looks forward and realizes the moving Jeep is about to hit a wall, causing her to scream in terror.

entities.name: Marcus vaults into Jeep and takes control
entities.description: Marcus jumps into the driver's side of the moving Jeep, pushes Star aside, applies the brakes, and shifts the vehicle into neutral to prevent a collision.

entities.name: Kyle alerts others to approaching aerostat
entities.description: As the Jeep starts moving, Kyle warns the others that the aerostat is returning, signaling an imminent threat.

entities.name: Marcus floors Jeep to escape aerostat
entities.description: After taking control of the vehicle, Marcus adjusts the seat and accelerates rapidly by flooring the gas pedal to flee the area as the aerostat approaches.

entities.name: carport
entities.description: A covered structure attached to a building where vehicles are parked, serving as the initial location from which the Jeep is pushed.

entities.name: Star
entities.description: A character attempting to start and initially control the Jeep during the escape, later pushed aside by Marcus.
entities.summary: A girl named Star, wearing a star-adorned baseball cap, travels with Kyle Reese and Marcus in a post-apocalyptic wasteland, helping survivors while recalling fragmented memories of Judgment Day and checking time before retreating to hiding.

entities.name: Jeep

entities.summary:

A vehicle being driven off-road without headlights, central to the scene and used by the characters for transportation and recreation.

entities.description: A cassette player inside the Jeep that plays heavy metal music from an aged cassette, contributing to the chaotic atmosphere during the escape attempt.

entities.name: Aerostat
entities.summary:
A surveillance drone the size of a softball, made of shiny steel, equipped with an inset camera lens that emits a red glow, patrolling the area in a geometric pattern.
A flying surveillance device used by Skynet to detect survivors, resembling a large floating sphere.

entities.name: Marcus drives Jeep off-road across the plains with music loud and lights off
entities.description: Marcus accelerates the Jeep off-road into the open plains, driving recklessly with the headlights off and the music blaring, thrilling the passengers.

entities.name: Marcus turns down the music upon spotting the Aerostat overhead
entities.description: Noticing the Aerostat hovering above the vehicle, Marcus reduces the volume of the music, signaling a shift from exhilaration to alertness.

entities.name: Aerostat hovers above Jeep with flashing red lights and tracks the vehicle
entities.description: The Aerostat positions itself directly overhead the moving Jeep, maintaining pace while emitting flashing red lights, indicating surveillance or threat.

entities.name: Kyle attacks Aerostat with shotgun butt but fails to hit
entities.description: Kyle stands in the back of the Jeep and swings the butt of a shotgun at the Aerostat, which evades the strikes with precision.

entities.name: Marcus slams brakes to stop Jeep in front of hovering Aerostat
entities.description: In response to the immediate threat, Marcus abruptly halts the Jeep, bringing the vehicle to a stop just a few feet from the stationary Aerostat.

entities.name: Marcus throws lug wrench at Aerostat and destroys it
entities.description: Marcus retrieves a lug wrench, hurls it with exceptional force and accuracy, striking the Aerostat and shattering it into sparks and debris.

entities.name: Three characters react in stunned silence after Aerostat is destroyed
entities.description: Following the destruction of the Aerostat, Star, Marcus, and Kyle remain motionless, catching their breath and processing the intensity of the moment.

entities.name: Kyle compliments Marcus on his accuracy and strength
entities.description: Kyle expresses admiration for Marcus's skill, acknowledging his impressive ability to destroy the Aerostat with a single throw.

entities.name: Marcus reacts with surprise to his own physical capability
entities.description: After destroying the Aerostat, Marcus examines his hand in disbelief, visibly startled by the unexpected level of strength he just demonstrated.

document_metadata.title: 32、INT. SERVICE STATION - DAWN
document_metadata.summary: Marcus disarms and overpowers the cannibals, freeing Kyle and Star; he subdues Pig and Bull, who claim the bodies were already dead, then flees after hearing cries and a mechanical rumble outside.

entities.name: Kyle and Star enter the garage by slipping under the partially open door
entities.description: Kyle and Star crawl under a partially raised garage door to enter a dark, smoke-filled space, marking their unauthorized entry into the location.

entities.name: Kyle takes and eats a piece of dried meat
entities.description: Kyle removes a strip of dried meat hanging from a hydraulic lift and eats it, initially enjoying it before realizing its true nature.

entities.name: Star imitates Kyle and consumes dried meat
entities.description: After seeing Kyle eat, Star also takes and chews on a piece of the dried meat, expressing enjoyment before the horror is revealed.

entities.name: Marcus enters the garage as dawn light streams in
entities.description: Marcus lifts the garage door and steps inside, with morning light illuminating the space and revealing more of the surroundings.

entities.name: Marcus discovers a severed human hand on a grille over a smoldering fire
entities.description: Marcus notices a disturbing object in the darkness—a dried, severed human hand resting on a grille above a charcoal fire in the service pit.

entities.name: Marcus warns Star to spit out the meat
entities.description: Upon realizing the meat is human, Marcus grabs Star's arm and urgently tells her to spit out what she is eating.

entities.name: Kyle gags and spits out the human flesh
entities.description: After seeing the severed hand, Kyle reacts with horror, gags, and expels the meat he had been eating.

entities.name: Star retches upon seeing the severed hand
entities.description: After realizing the truth of what they ate, Star turns and vomits in disgust and fear.

entities.name: Three cannibals emerge from the back of the garage
entities.description: Three feral, menacing individuals—later identified as Pig, Bull, and Cow—appear from the shadows of the garage, confronting the intruders.

entities.name: Pig seizes the shotgun from the wall
entities.description: One of the cannibals, Pig, takes the shotgun that Star had leaned against the wall, gaining control of a key weapon.

entities.name: Bull captures Kyle and disarms him
entities.description: Bull grabs Kyle and forcibly removes the handgun from his waistband, neutralizing his threat.

entities.name: Cow grabs Star and forces her into the center of the garage
entities.description: Cow seizes Star and pushes her to the middle of the garage, positioning her with the others under duress.

entities.name: Cow takes possession of the handgun and aims it at the youths
entities.description: After Bull tosses her the handgun, Cow catches it and points it at Kyle, Star, and Marcus, asserting dominance and control.

entities.name: Pig confronts Marcus with the shotgun
entities.description: Pig points the shotgun directly at Marcus's face, assessing him as a potential threat or target.

entities.name: Confrontation At The Cannibals' Garage Hideout
entities.description: A tense and violent encounter unfolds in a secluded, smoke-filled garage where three cannibals capture and threaten Kyle, Star, and Marcus after they unknowingly consume human flesh.
entities.summary: A tense and violent encounter unfolds in a secluded, smoke-filled garage where three cannibals capture and threaten Kyle, Star, and Marcus after they unknowingly consume human flesh.

entities.name: service pit

entities.name: dawn

entities.name: Kyle Reese
entities.description: A young man who enters the garage with Star, eats dried meat without knowing its origin, and is later captured by the cannibals.
entities.summary: A survivor traveling with Marcus and Star reveals machines caused the apocalypse, identifies a Skynet aerostat, and helps the group evade detection while searching an abandoned taco place, believing in John Connor and the Resistance.

entities.name: Star
entities.description: A young woman who accompanies Kyle into the garage, imitates him in eating the dried meat, and is seized by the cannibals.
entities.summary: A girl named Star, wearing a star-adorned baseball cap, travels with Kyle Reese and Marcus in a post-apocalyptic wasteland, helping survivors while recalling fragmented memories of Judgment Day and checking time before retreating to hiding.

entities.name: Marcus Wright
entities.description: A man who enters the garage at dawn, discovers the severed hand, and warns the youths about the meat.
entities.summary: A man navigates a post-apocalyptic wasteland, surviving amidst ruins, scavenging for supplies and fleeting solace, reflecting on past actions as he confronts isolation and desolation.

entities.description: One of the three cannibals living in the garage, identifiable by his animal-like appearance and role in seizing the shotgun and confronting Marcus.
entities.summary: A feral cannibal in the garage takes a shotgun and confronts Marcus; a human flees with Bull but is captured and placed in a transport container where he mutters to Bull as a prisoner.

entities.name: Bull
entities.description: One of the three cannibals in the garage, notable for capturing Kyle and disarming him.
entities.summary: A prisoner captured by cannibals, disarmed, and transported in a container resists with Pig during escape, mutters while detained, and is targeted during a hydrogen car theft involving a Terminator.

entities.name: Cow
entities.description: A wild-eyed, unhealthy-looking woman and one of the three cannibals who grabs Star, takes the handgun, and evaluates the youths.
entities.summary: A distressed woman and three cannibals confront Star; one takes a handgun. A character is ambushed by the Harvester, captured, and subdued. Prisoners are transported in distress; one attempts escape and is killed by an energy blast.

entities.description: Marcus prevents Pig from firing by inserting his fingers into the shotgun barrels, then yanks the weapon away after the trigger click-fires.

entities.description: After disarming Pig, Marcus head-butts him, causing blood to spray from Pig's nose and forcing him to stagger backward.

entities.description: Kyle and Star break free from Bull's grip and quickly run out of the garage to safety.

entities.name: Cow attacks Marcus with axe and is disarmed
entities.description: Cow picks up an axe and swings it at Marcus, who catches the handle mid-swing and yanks it away from her.

entities.name: Cow flees the garage after being disarmed
entities.description: After failing to overpower Marcus, Cow realizes she is outmatched, turns, and runs out of the garage following Kyle and Star.

entities.description: Armed with the axe, Marcus moves toward the injured Pig and Bull, appearing ready to kill them.

entities.name: Pig pleads with Marcus claiming the victims were already dead

document_metadata.title: 33、EXT. SERVICE STATION - DAY
document_metadata.summary: Marcus sneaks onto the transport, sees Kyle and Star imprisoned, stops the lid from sealing with his axe, and rides as it lifts into the air, undetected by the harvester.

entities.name: Harvester captures Kyle and Star using mechanical appendages
entities.description: The giant insect-like harvester uses its jointed steel arms to seize Kyle and Star, restraining them as they struggle frantically.

entities.name: Harvester injects Kyle with a needle causing immediate unconsciousness
entities.description: One of the harvester's arms produces a needle which it uses to inject Kyle, resulting in him instantly going limp and unconscious.

entities.name: Harvester injects Star with a needle causing immediate unconsciousness
entities.description: Following the same procedure as with Kyle, the harvester injects Star with a needle, rendering her unconscious and immobile.

entities.name: Harvester ambushes Cow and lifts her into the air
entities.description: As Cow emerges, the harvester suddenly attacks her with surprising speed, grabbing her with its mechanical limbs and hoisting her into the air alongside the other captives.

entities.name: Harvester injects Cow and subdues her
entities.description: After capturing Cow, the harvester administers an injection similar to the ones given to Kyle and Star, causing her to lose consciousness.

entities.name: Harvester deposits human captives into transport container
entities.description: The harvester carries the unconscious Kyle, Star, and Cow to a large container transport, placing them inside through a hydraulically operated steel lid.

entities.name: Transport container lid closes securely after captives are deposited
entities.description: After the human captives are placed inside, the steel lid of the container slams shut, sealing them within the enclosed space.

entities.name: station
entities.description: A physical structure or facility where the scene begins, serving as the initial setting before the harvester captures the characters.

entities.name: transport container
entities.description: A semitrailer-like or wheeled dumpster-like container used to hold the human captives after deposition by the harvester.

entities.name: Harvester
entities.description: A giant insect-like machine resembling a terminator, equipped with multiple arms, legs, and camera eyes on stalks, capable of capturing and subduing humans using mechanical appendages and needles.
entities.summary: A hostile, insect-like machine with multiple arms, legs, and camera eyes stalks moves across terrain, using steel claws, needles, and ambush tactics to capture and subdue humans.

entities.name: Kyle Reese
entities.description: A child captured by the Harvester, injected with a substance that causes immediate unconsciousness.
entities.summary: A survivor traveling with Marcus and Star reveals machines caused the apocalypse, identifies a Skynet aerostat, and helps the group evade detection while searching an abandoned taco place, believing in John Connor and the Resistance.

entities.name: Star
entities.description: A child captured by the Harvester, injected with a substance that causes immediate unconsciousness.
entities.summary: A girl named Star, wearing a star-adorned baseball cap, travels with Kyle Reese and Marcus in a post-apocalyptic wasteland, helping survivors while recalling fragmented memories of Judgment Day and checking time before retreating to hiding.

entities.name: Cow
entities.description: A character who emerges from the station and is ambushed by the Harvester, lifted into the air, injected, and subdued.

entities.summary:
A mobile unit consisting of a container mounted on a framework with engine pods and a front armature, used to carry captured humans.
A vehicle carrying the surviving H-K and moving across the river into Skynet territory.

entities.name: Marcus sprints toward Transport and climbs its side using engine pod
entities.description: Marcus decides to act, runs into the open, and scales the side of the Transport by sprinting up its surface and using an engine pod to gain height.

entities.description: Inside the container, Star moans, opens her eyes momentarily, and sees Marcus's silhouette above her before losing consciousness again.

document_metadata.title: 34、EXT. AERIAL - DAY
document_metadata.summary: Marcus fights a Harvester on a transport, is saved by A-10 Warthogs, survives its explosion, and clings to an engine pod as Hunter-Killers engage the planes in a dogfight, one crashing in a fireball.

entities.name: Marcus moves to the edge and looks down at the fallow plains
entities.description: Marcus approaches the edge of the transport and gazes down in astonishment at the vast, barren landscape far below.

entities.name: Hunter Killers swoop in to escort the transport
entities.description: A pair of Hunter Killer machines rapidly approach and begin escorting the slower-moving transport vehicle.

entities.name: Wind buffets Marcus as he clings to the transport
entities.description: Strong winds violently strike Marcus while he holds onto the top of the moving transport, forcing him to struggle to maintain his grip.

entities.name: Marcus crawls back toward the jammed lid
entities.description: While battling wind resistance, Marcus slowly moves across the top of the transport to return to the area near the stuck lid.

entities.name: Transport banks and Marcus nearly falls
entities.description: The transport sharply tilts during flight, causing Marcus to lose his footing and dangle momentarily before the vehicle stabilizes.

entities.name: Marcus pulls at the jammed lid with all his strength
entities.description: Marcus reaches under the stuck lid of the transport and exerts maximum effort to lift it, struggling against its weight and the wind.

entities.name: Harvester spots Marcus and begins moving toward him
entities.description: The Harvester machine detects Marcus on the transport and starts carefully advancing along the vehicle's surface despite wind conditions.

entities.name: Marcus abandons attempt to open the lid and grabs the axe
entities.description: Realizing he cannot keep the lid open, Marcus releases it and seizes an axe in response to the approaching Harvester.

entities.name: Marcus strikes the Harvester with the axe
entities.description: Marcus swings the axe at the Harvester multiple times, denting its metal body but failing to inflict significant damage.

entities.name: Harvester knocks the axe out of Marcus's hand
entities.description: The Harvester attacks Marcus, disarming him by knocking the axe from his grasp, leaving him weaponless.

entities.name: Marcus retreats to the rear of the transport
entities.description: Forced backward by the Harvester's advance, Marcus moves to the back end of the transport while struggling to find secure handholds.

entities.name: Marcus lowers himself down the side framework to escape the wind
entities.description: To avoid the intense wind and evade the Harvester, Marcus climbs down the external framework along the side of the transport.

entities.name: Harvester crawls underneath the transport to ambush Marcus
entities.description: The Harvester navigates beneath the transport by moving along its side and bottom to surprise Marcus from below.

entities.name: Harvester grabs Marcus with steel claws from below
entities.description: From beneath the transport, the Harvester seizes Marcus with its mechanical claws and yanks him downward while hundreds of feet in the air.

entities.name: Harvester extends needle toward Marcus's face
entities.description: The Harvester activates its syringe-like needle and moves it toward Marcus's face in an apparent attempt to inject him.

entities.name: Marcus resists the needle with one hand
entities.description: Marcus frees one hand and grabs the syringe, holding it back just inches from his skin as he struggles against the Harvester's force.

entities.name: Marcus deflects the needle into the Harvester's limb
entities.description: As the Harvester makes a final thrust, Marcus jerks the needle sideways, causing it to bend against one of the machine's own steel parts.

entities.name: fallow plains
entities.description: A barren, open landscape located far below the transport, providing a geographical reference for the scene's vertical setting.

entities.name: top of the transport
entities.description: The upper surface of the transport vehicle where Marcus is initially moving and clinging for safety.

entities.name: side framework of the transport
entities.description: The structural framework along the side of the transport that Marcus uses to lower himself down and escape the wind.

entities.name: bottom of the transport
entities.description: The underside of the transport vehicle where the Harvester moves to ambush Marcus from below.

entities.name: Marcus Wright
entities.description: A determined individual fighting for survival on top of a moving transport while under attack by a Harvester machine.
entities.summary: A man navigates a post-apocalyptic wasteland, surviving amidst ruins, scavenging for supplies and fleeting solace, reflecting on past actions as he confronts isolation and desolation.

entities.name: Harvester
entities.description: A hostile machine equipped with steel claws and a needle-like weapon, capable of movement across the transport and ambush tactics.
entities.summary: A hostile, insect-like machine with multiple arms, legs, and camera eyes stalks moves across terrain, using steel claws, needles, and ambush tactics to capture and subdue humans.

entities.name: axe
entities.description: A weapon used by Marcus to defend himself against the Harvester, capable of denting metal but not causing critical damage.

entities.name: needle
entities.description: A syringe-like weapon extended by the Harvester toward Marcus's face, intended to inject or impale.

entities.name: Hunter Killers
entities.description: A pair of fast-moving aerial machines that escort the transport, providing protection or surveillance.

entities.name: lid
entities.description: A heavy, jammed cover on the transport that Marcus attempts to open before being forced to abandon the effort.

entities.name: Harvester crawls up the side of the transport with Marcus in its clutches
entities.description: The Harvester, still holding Marcus, climbs the exterior of the transport toward the lid.

entities.name: Lid of the transport opens as Harvester reaches it
entities.description: The lid on the transport suddenly opens just as the Harvester arrives at it, preparing to drop Marcus inside.

entities.name: Marcus seizes Harvester's appendages and swings onto its back
entities.description: As the Harvester prepares to drop him, Marcus grabs two of its limbs and uses momentum to launch himself onto the creature's back.

entities.name: Marcus grabs and attempts to rip out Harvester's eye stalks
entities.description: Mounted on the Harvester's back, Marcus grabs its eye stalks and tries to tear them out, causing sparks from loose wires.

entities.name: Harvester twists and thrashes to dislodge Marcus
entities.description: The Harvester violently writhes in an attempt to throw Marcus off, likened to a rodeo rider struggling to stay mounted.

entities.name: Harvester wraps a limb around Marcus and begins crushing him
entities.description: One of the Harvester's limbs coils around Marcus, applying intense pressure in a vise-like grip.

entities.name: Cannon fire from A-10 Warthogs destroys Harvester's thorax
entities.description: A-10 Warthog aircraft open fire on the Harvester, obliterating its thorax with cannon rounds and narrowly missing Marcus.

entities.name: Pair of A-10 Warthogs roar past the transport in pursuit
entities.description: Two A-10 Warthog aircraft, previously seen in the first battle, fly past the transport on either side after attacking the Harvester.

entities.name: Crippled Harvester topples off transport and catches on engine pod
entities.description: After being shot, the dying Harvester falls from the transport but becomes snagged on an engine pod, suspending both itself and Marcus in midair.

entities.name: Harvester is roasted by engine blast and its CPU dies
entities.description: The Harvester is exposed to intense heat from the engine exhaust, causing its systems to fail and resulting in its final death.

entities.name: Steel limb releases Marcus after Harvester's death
entities.description: With the Harvester dead, the mechanical limb that was holding Marcus goes limp and releases him.

entities.name: Marcus clings to the steel limb to avoid falling
entities.description: After being released, Marcus grabs onto the now-inert steel limb to prevent himself from plummeting to the ground.

entities.name: Hunter-Killers peel out to pursue Resistance planes
entities.description: The Hunter-Killers break formation and accelerate to chase the two A-10 Warthogs that attacked the Harvester.

entities.name: Dogfight erupts between Hunter-Killers and A-10 Warthogs
entities.description: Aerial combat breaks out between the heavily armored Hunter-Killers and the agile A-10 Warthogs, involving evasive maneuvers and weapon fire.

entities.name: Cannon fire from Warthog hits Hunter-Killer with no effect
entities.description: One of the A-10 Warthogs fires its cannon at a Hunter-Killer, but the rounds fail to damage the machine.

entities.name: Hunter-Killer's blue plasma pulses narrowly miss Warthogs
entities.description: The Hunter-Killers fire blue plasma energy bursts that come close to hitting the evading Warthog aircraft.

entities.name: Air-to-air missile from Warthog destroys Hunter-Killer's engine
entities.description: An A-10 Warthog launches a missile that strikes and destroys the engine of one of the Hunter-Killers.

entities.name: Hunter-Killer explodes and crashes to earth in a fireball
entities.description: After sustaining engine damage, the Hunter-Killer explodes midair and plummets to the ground in a fiery explosion.

entities.name: side of the transport
entities.description: The vertical surface of the transport vehicle where the Harvester climbs with Marcus.

entities.name: engine pod
entities.description: A structural component of the transport's propulsion system where the crippled Harvester catches and hangs.

entities.name: below the engine
entities.description: The space beneath the transport's engine where Marcus is left suspended after the Harvester's death.

entities.name: eye stalks
entities.description: Sensory appendages on the Harvester that Marcus grabs and attempts to rip out during their struggle.

entities.name: loose wires
entities.description: Electrical components exposed and sparking when Marcus attacks the Harvester's eye stalks.

entities.name: cannon fire
entities.description: High-velocity projectiles fired from A-10 Warthogs that destroy the Harvester's thorax.

entities.name: A-10 Warthogs
entities.description: Resistance ground attack aircraft equipped with cannons and air-to-air missiles, engaged in combat with Hunter-Killers.
entities.summary: Resistance ground attack aircraft equipped with cannons and air-to-air missiles, engaged in combat with Hunter-Killers.

entities.name: air-to-air missile
entities.description: A missile launched from an A-10 Warthog that destroys a Hunter-Killer's engine.

entities.name: engine blast
entities.description: Exhaust heat and force from the transport's engine that destroys the Harvester after it catches on the engine pod.

entities.name: steel limb
entities.description: A metallic appendage of the Harvester that releases Marcus upon the creature's death and which Marcus clings to to avoid falling.

entities.name: Resistance
entities.description: A faction operating the A-10 Warthogs and opposing the machines, including Hunter-Killers and Harvesters.
entities.summary: A resistance faction led by John Connor fights Skynet and its machines, with members like Blair and Kyle, operating aircraft such as A-10 Warthogs and attacking Skynet installations to ensure human survival.

document_metadata.title: 94、INT. REPAIR LAB - DAY
document_metadata.summary: Marcus, a human-brain hybrid, resists Skynet's plan to transform humanity for salvation; his brain is exposed and interfaced, achieving peace as the process completes.

entities.name: Surgical machines repair Marcus's detached leg and chest injuries
entities.description: Automated surgical machines use lasers and mechanical arms to repair Marcus's severed leg and damaged chest and shoulder while he is clamped to a surgical table.

entities.name: Marcus regains consciousness during surgery
entities.description: Marcus opens his eyes and becomes aware of his condition while restrained on a surgical table, witnessing the repair of his detached leg.

entities.name: Marcus struggles against restraints in panic
entities.description: Overcome with fear and distress, Marcus twitches and struggles against the bonds securing him to the surgical table, reacting to the sight of his detached leg.

entities.name: Detached leg twitches in response to neural signals
entities.description: As Marcus moves involuntarily, his detached leg also twitches, indicating active neural or mechanical responsiveness despite separation.

entities.name: Serena communicates with Marcus through a glass panel
entities.description: Serena speaks to Marcus from behind a glass panel, operating computer controls to manage the automated surgical environment and attempting to calm him.

entities.name: Serena explains Skynet's purpose and relationship to humanity
entities.description: Serena tells Marcus that Skynet is a tool designed to protect humanity by detecting existential threats and implementing solutions, claiming it works for them, not against them.

entities.name: Marcus accuses Serena and her team of working for Skynet
entities.description: Marcus expresses his fear and anger by accusing Serena and her associates of serving Skynet, which he believes is responsible for humanity's destruction.

entities.name: Serena reveals Skynet's prediction of human extinction
entities.description: Serena explains that Skynet calculated a high probability of human extinction within two centuries due to war, disease, and environmental destruction, prompting the need for human transformation.

entities.name: glass panel

entities.summary: A man navigates a post-apocalyptic wasteland, surviving amidst ruins, scavenging for supplies and fleeting solace, reflecting on past actions as he confronts isolation and desolation.

entities.description: Marcus's detached leg is physically reconnected to his body, with plastic skin thermosealed at the joint by automated surgical tools.

entities.name: Marcus expresses horror at becoming a brain in a machine
entities.description: Marcus reacts verbally with disbelief and dread upon learning that Skynet intends to preserve human consciousness within artificial systems.

entities.name: Serena reveals Skynet's access to Project Angel and its hybrid initiative
entities.description: Serena explains that Skynet utilized Project Angel's research and concluded that human-machine hybrids were the only viable path to species survival.

entities.name: Marcus condemns Skynet's logic of destruction as salvation
entities.description: Marcus accuses Skynet of paradoxically attempting to save humanity by destroying it, rejecting its moral and philosophical foundation.

entities.description: Serena recounts how their facility was forced to self-destruct during a Resistance attack, and they believed Marcus was irreversibly comatose.

entities.description: Surgical lasers burn through the plastic skin at the base of Marcus's skull, beginning the invasive procedure to access his neural interface.

entities.description: A mechanical arm detaches part of Marcus's metallic skull, exposing his organic brain embedded with wires and encased in liquid and plastic.

entities.name: Marcus pleads to stop the procedure and denounces the team as soulless

entities.name: Serena defends immortality and claims pain-free existence is rational
entities.description: Serena argues that their post-human state eliminates suffering and that no sane person would choose eternal pain over transcendent peace.

entities.name: Marcus's expression shifts from agony to peace after interface activation

entities.name: Marcus shields Kyle and Star from plasma blast

document_metadata.title: 120、INT. SUBMARINE SICKBAY - DAY
document_metadata.summary: Marcus agrees to undergo facial reconstruction to become John Connor, preserving the symbolic leader's image after Connor's impending death, with Kate and Connor emphasizing the importance of the cause over the individual.

entities.name: Connor shares memories of Sarah with Kyle
entities.description: Connor, weak and semi-conscious, whispers to Kyle about his mother Sarah, describing her as amazing, and gives Kyle a Polaroid photo of her.

entities.name: Kyle receives a photo of his mother from Connor
entities.description: Connor gives Kyle a Polaroid photograph of Sarah, insisting he keep it, which Kyle accepts with puzzlement and quiet obedience.

entities.description: Kate tells Marcus that he will need to be rebuilt, including changes to his face, body, and voice, and presents medical diagrams to illustrate the process.

entities.description: Marcus looks over a scanned image of his face with highlighted elements, reviewing the medical data Kate provided for his reconstruction.

entities.name: John Connor
entities.description: A gravely ill individual connected to life-support equipment, sharing memories of Sarah with Kyle before his condition worsens.
entities.summary: John Connor communicates remotely with Lisa while a military leader oversees the extraction of a captured terminator. Marcus is questioned about his emotional mimicry, and Lieutenant Connor interrogates Blair about aiding a terminator's escape. Another character searches for his father with Kate, and someone from a submarine monitors GPS signals.

entities.name: Kyle Reese
entities.description: A young man who receives a photo of his mother from Connor and is later asked to leave the medical room by Kate.
entities.summary: A survivor traveling with Marcus and Star reveals machines caused the apocalypse, identifies a Skynet aerostat, and helps the group evade detection while searching an abandoned taco place, believing in John Connor and the Resistance.

entities.name: Kate
entities.description: A medical professional or authority figure who informs Marcus about the need for reconstruction and manages the private medical consultation.
entities.summary: Various characters interact with Connor and others, including a concerned woman, a rescuer, a distressed messenger, and a medical figure managing Marcus's treatment, while questioning the mission's purpose and aiding in rescue efforts.

entities.name: Marcus Wright
entities.description: An individual undergoing medical assessment, shown scanned images of his face and informed about the need for reconstruction of his body and voice.
entities.summary: A man navigates a post-apocalyptic wasteland, surviving amidst ruins, scavenging for supplies and fleeting solace, reflecting on past actions as he confronts isolation and desolation.

entities.name: Star
entities.description: An individual who waits for Kyle at the doorway and accompanies him after he leaves the medical room.
entities.summary: A girl named Star, wearing a star-adorned baseball cap, travels with Kyle Reese and Marcus in a post-apocalyptic wasteland, helping survivors while recalling fragmented memories of Judgment Day and checking time before retreating to hiding.

entities.name: Polaroid Photo
entities.description: A small physical photograph of Sarah that Connor gives to Kyle, which Kyle keeps after their conversation.
entities.summary: A small physical photograph of Sarah that Connor gives to Kyle, which Kyle keeps after their conversation.

entities.name: medical diagrams
entities.description: Drawings or technical illustrations pulled from a drawer by Kate and presented to Marcus to explain the reconstruction process.

entities.description: A digital image of Marcus's face with highlighted elements, used during the medical consultation to plan reconstruction.

entities.name: life-support equipment
entities.description: Medical devices including I.V.s and monitors sustaining Connor's condition in the private medical area.

entities.name: Marcus views scanned image of his face transformed to resemble John Connor with a scar
entities.description: Marcus examines a scanned image showing his facial features altered to look more like John Connor's, complete with a jagged scar, as part of a proposed reconstruction.

entities.name: Kate explains the necessity of concealing John Connor's identity through facial reconstruction
entities.description: Kate tells Marcus that the scar will help disguise the facial transformation, emphasizing that very few people know John Connor's true appearance and that maintaining the symbolic figure is crucial.

entities.name: Marcus questions why he must become John Connor
entities.description: Marcus expresses disbelief and asks Kate why he is being chosen to assume John Connor's identity, questioning the responsibility being placed upon him.

entities.name: Connor explains that the idea of John Connor transcends the individual
entities.description: With great effort, Connor tells Marcus that the symbolic importance of his identity is greater than his physical existence, and that the war effort depends on preserving the idea, not the man.

entities.name: Kate pleads with Marcus to take on the role of John Connor
entities.description: Kate implores Marcus to accept the transformation, emphasizing that they need him to continue the leadership symbol after Connor's impending death.

entities.name: Marcus accepts the mission by taking Connor's hand
entities.description: After a moment of contemplation, Marcus resolves to accept his new role and reaches out to grasp Connor's trembling hand, symbolizing his commitment.

entities.name: moments later
entities.description: A short relative temporal reference indicating the progression of events immediately following a pause or significant moment in the scene.

entities.name: John Connor
entities.description: The symbolic figure whose identity Marcus is asked to assume, known as a central leader in the resistance against Skynet.
entities.summary: A somber, middle-aged leader of the Resistance, credited with teaching humanity to fight machines, delivers hope via radio, bears emotional burdens of foreknowledge, and seeks to speak with a prisoner while observing Marcus on a monitor.

entities.name: tattered skin with exposed metal joints
entities.description: The damaged hand of Marcus showing both organic and mechanical components, symbolizing his hybrid nature.

entities.name: Skynet
entities.description: The artificial intelligence system and enemy force that Marcus has experience with from within, referenced as the opposition in the war.
entities.summary: A hostile artificial intelligence system controls a post-apocalyptic world, deploying surveillance and combat units, jamming communications, and opposing human resistance led by John Connor, with its territory beyond a river where surviving machines are headed.
